svg.title: My first attempt
svg.desc: A faithful web recreation of the personal-brand exercise slide.
svg.text: I tried to put the “me” into one sentence.
The framework forced me to name the qualities and contribution I hoped people would consistently experience from me.

text.tspan: I am the explorer who embraces new challenges with curiosity and resilience, who is
known for caring deeply, building trust, and lifting others along the way, and helps
people find new possibilities while feeling supported on their journey.

svg.text: At the time, I thought the exercise was mainly about finding the right words.
Looking back, the more important question was whether those words would show up in how I lived and behaved.
